vibe_rationale: Surf-town music day built around the WSL with mainstream Australian indie line-ups; pleasant, but a WSL-branded day rather than a scene-led event.
fit_notes: Adult beach crowd on the opening weekend of the Gold Coast Pro, with an active-lifestyle setting but a generic music audience. WSL is the single presenting brand, so entry is a side role, and a touring promoter with three stops could support a multi-city partnership.
